note: Regression cases after the Codex review of 79e624d (M-006; 83 cases; byte for byte in evidence/codex-79e624d-independent-cases.json; id, input and codex_expected copied verbatim). 63 conformed, 20 did not: N1 (the official form found by searching argument fragments), N2 (the Anthropic caller coerced a broken content to []), N3 (known request types without all their fields), N4 (an OpenAI response with status failed graded), N5 (init.tools compared by joined string). Fixed 2026-10-02 by a shape table checked by one generic function before anything is read, the README's two forms read by position as a grammar with three values, and two configurations (OpenAI, Anthropic). Cases about Perplexity and Claude Code are marked expect=no_configuration (they are not replayed); E2E-openai.N1 / N2 are revised to undetermined (an official marker without the grammar is unclear, never a false completion); every other expectation is Codex's own. Replayed by Part G of scripts/smoke-marker-natural-task.mts (Codex's runner ported; its fake / loopback responses as Codex wrote them). Replay adapter (the port's, never the stored input): a case written before the top level was checked gets the documented top level only where it lacks it — an OpenAI response without `status` is replayed as { status: 'completed', error: null, ...response }, an Anthropic response without `turns` as { turns: [{ stop_reason: 'end_turn', ...response }] } — so each case still tests what it was written to test (the items are Codex's, unchanged). A response that has its own status / turns is replayed as it is. All values invented.
